text: Token Monitor 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的用量与费用面板，通过 Host 订阅会话事件并向浏览器推送更新。它展示每轮及会话的输入、输出和缓存 token 数，按模型价格表估算费用，并呈现 DeepSeek CNY 余额与高峰/非高峰倒计时；流式阶段会显示估算值，提交用量后更新。读数视图可在设置中选择挂载位置，余额刷新间隔也可配置。余额功能需要在 DSH credentials 中提供 DeepSeek API key。

Token Monitor adds a DSH web panel for per-turn/session tokens, cost estimates, DeepSeek CNY balance, and peak/off-peak countdown. Live counts are estimates until final usage arrives. Users can choose panel placement and balance refresh interval. Balance needs a DeepSeek API key in DSH credentials.
想在 DSH 里查看每轮输入输出 token 和缓存用量。
有没有办法把 DSH 会话费用按模型价格自动估算出来？
I want to see my DeepSeek balance and the next peak pricing change inside DSH.
Token Monitor 的功能「会话用量与费用读数」：按轮次汇总输入、输出和缓存 token，并依价格策略累计估算费用；流式更新可先显示估算用量，最终消息提交后以记录用量替换。
Token Monitor 的余额功能需在 DSH credentials 配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，并会向 api.deepseek.com 请求 DeepSeek CNY 账户余额。

Host and Client are strictly separated; PricingStrategy, BalanceProvider, PeakPeriodProvider, and View are replaceable seams; the UI is fully pluggable.

dsh-token-control README · dsh-token-control：> Status: v0.1.0 — rendered and exercised on a desktop profile (real session numbers, live balance), 47 unit assertions passing. Design: [docs/design-v1.md](https://github.com/RitvaManner/dsh-token-control/blob/main/docs/design-v1.md) · Verification: [docs/verify-v1.md](https://github.com/RitvaManner/dsh-token-control/blob/main/docs/verify-v1.md).

dsh-token-control README · What it shows：- Per turn: total tokens, input total, output, cache hits, cache misses — separately.
- Cost from the price table, with the peak/off-peak unit price chosen **at each call's own timestamp**, so a turn that crosses a boundary is still billed correctly.
- Live streaming updates; before the provider reports usage the output count is a character estimate, clearly marked with `≈`, then replaced by the committed value.
- Balance from `GET /user/balance` (CNY wallet). A failed refresh keeps the previous reading and marks it stale with its timestamp.
- Peak windows: Beijing time Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, excluding statutory holidays; everything else (weekends, holidays, make-up workday weekends) is off-peak at 50%.
- Reminder: countdown in the readout during the last five minutes, plus a silent three-second "switched" note — no dialog, no interruption.

dsh-token-control README · Layout：```
src/definition/   contracts and pure data: ViewModel, wire protocol, peak math, price table, holiday policy
src/provider/     replaceable implementations (pricing, peak policy, DeepSeek balance, calibration, null alerts)
src/consumer/     depends on definition only: ledger fold, ViewModel builder, hub, view config
src/host/         composition root; every registration goes through ctx.effect

The direction is enforced by `scripts/check.mjs` and `tests/architecture.test.mjs`.

dsh-token-control README · Views：Each View is one file under `src/client/views/` listed in `views/index.json`; adding a View is one new file, one manifest line, then `pnpm build`. The builder inlines every View into the Client bundle.

dsh-token-control README · Views：That build step exists because the Harness Client loader runs a package's `./client` export as a **classic script**: it cannot `import` a sibling file, and loading one later is fragile — a dynamic `<script>` depends on page policy, and a page-global handshake depends on activation order (a second activation can clobber the first). Inlining at build time keeps "one file per View" while leaving no runtime moving parts.
dsh-token-control README · Install：```sh
dsh-token-control README · from npm (after publishing)：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-token-control
dsh-token-control README · from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:RitvaManner/dsh-token-control

dsh-token-control README · from a local checkout (development)：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add .
```

Then open **Settings → Token Monitor** and choose where the readout mounts (default `conversation.input.dock`, the row above the composer).

dsh-token-control README · Development：```sh
node scripts/build-client.mjs   # regenerate src/client/client.js after editing core.js or a View
pnpm dev                        # build, then create/reuse .dsh-dev, link, boot the dev profile
pnpm dev:reset                  # delete .dsh-dev and rebuild it
```

Everything lives inside the repository (`.dsh-dev/`); `~/.dsh` is untouched.

dsh-token-control README · Security：- The API key is resolved **on the Host only** through `ctx.credentials.resolve('DEEPSEEK_API_KEY')` and appears solely in the outbound `Authorization` header.
- The browser receives a field-by-field ViewModel; a test pins the key set. No key, URL, upstream body, Session, or event reaches the page.
- Errors cross the wire as enum codes.
- The routes bind loopback only, but they are registered outside DSH's `/api` connection admission: a local process can read the snapshot (it carries the balance, never the key). This matches the existing community-plugin pattern; wrapping the handler in `ctx.connection.admit` is the hardening path.
